title: Stock futures rise slightly after rip-roaring rally leads Dow to record closing high: Live updates
summary: Major U.S. stock indices surged Monday with the Dow reaching a record closing high, driven by Amazon becoming the first publicly traded company to exceed $3 trillion in market capitalization. The milestone reflects growing investor confidence in Big Tech's long-term growth potential.
content: The major stock averages surged Monday, with the Dow closing at a record high, as Amazon eclipsed $3 trillion in market cap for the first time.

zh.title: 股票期货小幅上涨，道琼斯指数创历史新高：实时更新
zh.summary: 美国主要股指周一大幅上涨，道琼斯指数创历史新高，由亚马逊成为首家市值超过3万亿美元的上市公司所推动。这一里程碑反映了投资者对科技巨头长期增长潜力信心的增强。

title: US states sue to block Trump tariffs impacting dozens of countries
summary: U.S. states have filed lawsuits to block Trump tariffs affecting dozens of countries, which were imposed on claims that 60 trading partners failed to address forced labor issues. The legal challenge represents growing state-level opposition to the tariff policy.
content: The duties were imposed over claims that 60 US trading partners have failed to tackle forced labour.

zh.title: 美国各州起诉阻止影响数十国的特朗普关税
zh.summary: 美国各州已提起诉讼，阻止影响数十个国家的特朗普关税政策。这些关税基于60个贸易伙伴未能解决强迫劳动问题的声称而实施。此项法律诉讼代表了各州对该关税政策不断增长的反对声浪。

title: India to raise up to $3.3 billion by selling stake in country’s largest life insurer at 10% discount
summary: India's government plans to raise $3.3 billion by selling a discounted stake in the country's largest life insurance company. The divestment represents a significant effort to boost government revenue.
content: Indian government plans to raise up to $3.3 billion by selling its stake in the country's top life insurance company.

zh.title: 印度计划以10%折扣出售该国最大人寿保险公司股份，筹资33亿美元
zh.summary: 印度政府计划通过以折扣价出售该国最大人寿保险公司的股份来筹集33亿美元。这次资产剥离代表了印度政府提高政府收入的重大努力。

title: Why is Trump Media selling early access to Trump's Truth Social posts?
summary: Trump Media offers early access to Truth Social posts from influential accounts at costs up to $100,000 monthly, providing subscribers milliseconds of advance notice before public posting. The premium service represents a new monetization strategy for the social platform.
content: The service reportedly costs up to $100,000 (£74,170) per month and offers access to posts from influential accounts milliseconds before they appear online.

zh.title: 特朗普媒体为什么在销售特朗普Truth Social帖子的提前访问权?
zh.summary: 特朗普媒体以每月最高10万美元的成本为有影响力的账户提供Truth Social帖子的提前访问权，为订阅者提供毫秒级的提前发布通知。该付费服务代表了该社交平台的新的盈利战略。
